manual.razor_wire.line2: {0}Razorwire is a wire with sharpened pieces of metal attached. It will slow and cut any entity that tries to move through it.
manual.razor_wire.line3: Razorwire can only be removed with Wirecutters, any other attempts will damage the player. Additionally, LV wires can be connected to electrify the razorwire for extra damage.
